title: Chapter 524
paragraphs: Chapter 524
Episode 144. For a Friend (2)
From the perspective of the ordinary people, it had been a normal everyday life until just a few days ago.
However, now they too could sense the thick clouds of war that pervaded throughout the empire.
Everyone knew that the emperor's sword was not pointed at an external force, but at Hyran, who had been called the pillar of the empire.
"I! I am well aware that the greatest swordsman of the empire has been fighting for the royal family and the people for a long time."
In the square in front of the imperial palace.
The emperor of the empire, Amir Biment, stood on a massive golden palanquin, looking down at the crowd. The palanquin was held up by about two hundred convicts, dressed in red robes.
The crowd felt puzzled by the emperor's sudden announcement, but they dared not express it.
The emperor mentioned the pretext for his purge was rebellion and insurrection.
"You might be wondering. Exactly what kind of rebellion did the Lord of Sword Emperor commit. And I know you may dislike it, I am not unaware that you prefer Ron Hyran more than me."
The emperor slowly looked down at his people.

"I, as the ruler of the empire, trusted my most loyal subject, Ron Hyran. And as a human, I respected and admired him, so I can't hide my resentment. However, Lord Sword Emperor Ron Hyran ignored not only my orders but also my earnest requests, plunging the empire into terror, war, and the threat of destruction."
At the emperor's gesture, two banners, torn and charred, unfolded from the poles on either side of the palanquin. They were the banners of the empire and Hyran.

"Everyone will remember the day when the rebellion took place in Sword Emperor City. These flags were torn that day, and I am about to inform all the people about the cause of the terror that happened that day. It was... because of an object that Hyran had."
For the first time, the crowd gathered in the square murmured.
Then the emperor gave a nod to the side, and a warrior dressed in Hyran's armor stepped forward.
It was 'Tion Hyran', the second son of Ron Hyran and the knight of Hyran.
After the Sword Emperor City terror, there were many traitors within Hyran. They were all pushed aside by Dante and treated by Ron Hyran as 'nonexistent'.
They never imagined betraying Ron due to his authority, but they saw an opportunity when Sword Emperor City took an unprecedented hit and even the royal family backed them.
Tion was the first, and the most proactive, to betray Hyran among them.
"... In my family, there is a white stone that is handed down only from the lord to the lord."

Originally, Tion had no idea about it, but the emperor informed him for this occasion. Unlike Hyran, who had been keeping a threatening secret through lord-to-lord succession, the emperor had no hesitation in disclosing the white stone to the public.
The crowd's gaze at Tion was filled with contempt.
Unless they were fools, they could not help but realize that he had betrayed his family and stood here, coveting the power of Hyran, which was about to be handed over to Dante.

"It might be hard to believe, but if that white stone can be refined and used, it has the power to support all the magic equipment in the empire and make the empire several times richer in an instant."
From the perspective of the crowd, it was an absurd and infuriating story.
"Uuuuuu-!"
In the end, the crowd booed Tion.
As the Emperor said earlier, Hyran is a family more beloved by the people than the royal family. Those gathered in the square wanted to stone him to death right away.
"Your Majesty."
The Chief of the Royal Guard, 'Alton Hyran', met the Emperor's gaze, signaling that he would suppress the commotion at a moment's notice.
However, the Emperor, with a smirk, ordered him to let it be.
"What's the big deal if they're just making a bit of noise? Let them vent a bit."
"Yes, Your Majesty."
The Emperor wasn't giving a speech out of fear of public opinion regarding the purge of Hyran or concern that the people might rise up in revolt to defend Hyran.
Firstly, it was to expose Hyran's secrets and put pressure on them, and secondly, because he genuinely loved the people, in his own way.
He was encouraging them to raise their voices a little, to show some of their displeasure, to vent their anger.
"After all, they have no power or will to stop me. Even though they like Hyran more than me, they won't truly risk their lives for it. I find their innocent and annoying behavior cute and lovely."
The Emperor's eyes glowed as if he genuinely found the people adorable.

"......Hence, His Majesty had long ago ordered our family to return the white stone to the royal family. It's called 'returning' because the stone was originally entrusted to Hyran by a previous Emperor."
Of course, the royal family had never entrusted the white stone to Hyran. It was just a story made up since the general public couldn't know the truth.
"Rubbish!"
The boos grew more intense.
"But as you can see, the Sword Emperor, Lon Hyran, has not obeyed His Majesty's command. Even when enemies coveting the stone launched a terror attack on Sword Emperor Castle and imperial soil."
"Get lost! You filthy traitor!"

"Bionic golems and unknown monstrous creatures threatened the empire. Because of the stone! Yet, Hyran does not relinquish their greed and does not return the stone to the royal family. As a member of the family, I know better than anyone that the Sword Emperor is plotting treason using its power."
Clap!
When the Emperor clapped his hands, the angry crowd instantly fell silent.

"Tion Hyran's testimony may seem dubious. I also know that it's a sudden story that may be hard to accept. But listen, my people. If Hyran returns the stone now, I am willing to forgive their sedition and rebellion."
By this point in the speech, curiosity was forming alongside anger in the hearts of the crowd.
What the heck is this white stone? Does it really exist? If so, why won't Hyran hand it over to the royal family?
It was natural for such questions to arise.
"I, Amir Bimonte, the emperor of the empire, declare. I will cease the purge as soon as Hyran returns the stone. But if they refuse to beg for my mercy until

"The Emperor of the Empire, Amir Biment. I declare. The moment Hiran returns the stone, the purge will stop. However, if they do not ask for my forgiveness until the end, the Black Emperor's City will turn to ash and disappear."
The content of the emperor's speech was quickly relayed to the Black Emperor's City.

"The emperor, this bastard...! How could he do this to Hiran. A white stone? It's not even funny! He makes up such nonsense because he lacks justification? And he calls himself the supreme ruler of the empire!"
"That madman will definitely pay. The Emperor, they flatter him and think Hiran is really weak and stayed still."
"The throne will be dyed with his blood. The one who deserves to sit there is not Biment, but Hiran from the beginning. If it weren't for Hiran, the empire couldn't even exist!"
The warriors gathered in the meeting room were raising their voices in anger.
Most of them seemed ready to invade the imperial palace and fight right away.
However, there was a definite sense of unease in the hearts of the warriors.
The unease had begun even before the emperor's speech.
"We should not just gather like this, we should go first! What the dignity of the Black Emperor is, what the name means. We must teach that brat."

"He's falsely accusing us of rebellion, we should show what real rebellion is. A few traitors have defected, and the emperor has raised an army. As long as Lord Ron is here, they will eventually beg before our sword!"
They all shouted, looking at one person seated at the top.
It was Dante Hiran, the head of the Hiran family.
Dante barely managed to keep his exhaustion from showing on his face. However, his bloodshot eyes and dry lips couldn't be hidden.
"Bring Lord Ron...!"
"Lord Ron is...!"
The unease of the warriors was none other than because of the mastermind who summoned all of them here just with his dignity, Ron Hiran.
It had been several days since the warriors gathered, but Ron had not yet shown himself to them even once.
'Grandfather....'
Now Dante knew Ron's condition too. A while ago, Ron's illness had become so severe that it couldn't be hidden.
Ron is currently unconscious.
Dante had been commanding the Black Emperor's City in his place. And as time went by, the gathered warriors were also doubting. Whether the Black Emperor was really in good health.
They couldn't dispel that doubt.

Ron's absence was as good as the entire Hiran family's absence. It wasn't that there were no notable people in Hiran besides Ron, but it was clear as day what the outcome would be if they went to war without him.
Feelings of pressure, helplessness, and nausea surged.
For days he couldn't sleep and experienced dizziness, and if he didn't concentrate, he suffered from convulsions all over his body.
'My weak body is making things difficult even at times like this...'
Dante clenched his teeth and made eye contact with the warriors.
It seemed like he had to tell the truth.
"... My grandfather is currently unconscious due to his worsening condition."
At Dante's words, the angry voices of the warriors subsided. Those who had already noticed were not shocked, but those who didn't know felt as if they had been struck by lightning.
"Lord Ron... is unconscious, you say? Could it be that the injury he received that day has worsened?"
"Why are you telling us this now?"
"If Lord Ron is not here, then the war...!"
As Dante was about to answer, an old knight spoke up, clicking his tongue.

"If Lord Ron is not here, will you not fight alongside Hiran? You are all talking nonsense. Are you not knights without Lord Ron, but mere peasants? We came to fight against the emperor's tyranny, to protect our friendship with Hiran, not to overthrow the empire with Lord Ron as the leader."
His name was Shuras Helter, the head of the Helter family.
Shuras's words avoided an uncomfortable response, but as long as Ron did not rise from his sickbed, Dante had no means to dispel their anxiety.
Even with a strong bond, they faced formidable enemies, and many of the warriors couldn't help but think about the cracks created by Ron's absence.
'If Lord Ron is not here, the war is doomed.'
'If we lose the fight against the emperor, not only will we die, but our relatives and family members will be brutally killed as well...'
Moreover, as soon as they learned that Ron was sick, they also thought of this.
'If the white stone the emperor mentioned... really exists?'
'If the emperor's speech is true, it would be best to return the stone and end the situation. Should we hope that the outrageous story is true...?'
Silence flowed.
Just as someone was about to ask if the emperor's speech was true, urgent footsteps were heard from outside. It was the sound of commanders rushing in.
"Head of the family! The movement of the emperor's troops has been confirmed. The vanguard will arrive at the Black Emperor's City within three hours...!"
